overview: Split 0009g into two conflict-aware child PRDs so polish can run in parallel without over-fragmenting scope.
goals: Reduce merge conflicts by separating route/file ownership.
Keep polish execution parallel where blocker sets differ.
Preserve deterministic trust-copy and exclusion guardrails.
Keep each child scope small and executable.
nonGoals: Split 0009g into many micro-slices that increase merge overhead.
successMetrics: Two child PRDs exist and all PRD JSON files parse.
Child slices use explicit story-level blockers.
Sequencing notes provide earliest-start triggers for both child slices.

resolvedDecisions.decision: Keep mandatory 3-check polish gate unchanged while using a two-slice structure.
details: W-C3/W-C4/W-C5/W-C7/W-C11 exclusions remain auditable in final sign-off.

routes.name: Detail Surfaces
routes.purpose: Primary ownership area for 0009g2 (report/viewer/exports/chat + final guardrails).

uiNotes: Use shared components in apps/web/app/ui and v5-final token/preset conventions.
Prefer route-local polish edits to minimize shared-file conflicts.
Keep cross-surface guardrail sign-off in a single final story.
rules: Each child PRD must define explicit blocked-by story IDs.
Keep route ownership boundaries clear to reduce merge collisions.
No hardcoded trust claims, IDs, timestamps, or unsupported capability promises.
Keep excluded wireframe items out of scope and auditable.
qualityGates: JSON parse checks for umbrella + child PRDs

parallelizationPlan.notes: Run in parallel once each slice's blocker set is complete.
Run final cross-surface exclusion/trust audit after 0009g1 implementation stories are complete.

stories.title: Split 0009g into two child PRDs
stories.description: As an engineering lead, I want two bounded child slices so we can execute polish in parallel without high merge-conflict overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Two child PRD folders with prd.md + prd.json exist under 0009g.
Example: one slice owns /matters + setup/demo and one slice owns /matters/:id detail surfaces.
Negative: no third/fourth child slice with overlapping ownership.

stories.title: Define explicit blockers and earliest starts
stories.description: As a planning lead, I want clear blockers for each child slice so teams can start at the earliest safe point.
acceptanceCriteria: Each child slice lists hard blockers with story IDs.

stories.title: Preserve mandatory gate and exclusions
stories.description: As a product team, we want split execution that keeps the same quality and exclusion guardrails.
acceptanceCriteria: Both child slices include mandatory checks relevant to scope.
Example: final 0009g2 story runs exclusion matrix and trust-copy pass/fail checks after 0009g1 completes.
